# SaveOptions type

Options for an instance's `save()`<!-- -->, with `returning` widened to accept a column list.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type SaveOptions = Modify<InstanceSaveOptionsOrigin, ReturningOptions>;
```
**References:** [Modify](/api/sequelize/latest/sequelize.modify/)<!-- -->, [ReturningOptions](/api/sequelize/latest/sequelize.returningoptions/)

## Remarks

Cast to this at the call site when TypeScript objects to a `returning` column list; [ReturningOptions](/api/sequelize/latest/sequelize.returningoptions/) explains what the list does.
